When comparing how a tip fits the natural nail, do not confuse "it covers the nail" with "it is the right choice." 想让手指显修长，看的是整体比例和边线过渡，不是把自由缘修尖就完事。局部过窄、根部: Making fingers look longer and slimmer is about overall proportions and side-line transitions, not simply filing the free edge to a point. One area may be too narrow, the base may widen abruptly, or the transition may be harsh. Each area may have been filed individually, yet the whole can still look unbalanced. My mistake was trying to rescue an already misplaced tip by narrowing it later, which left thickness concentrated in one area when viewed from the side. If the position is unbalanced, return to tip selection and fit first. If the connection looks appropriate but the finished nail looks wide, review the outline. 我的做法是两份记录：一张不加滤镜的完成照，沿颜色深浅变化标位置；另一份只记反光不: I keep two records: an unfiltered finished photo marked where the color changes in intensity, and a separate record of only the breaks in the reflection.
